dict.string: Mom looks in Downloads for installers and unpacked archives you're done with, and for copies of the same file. She only reads; nothing goes until you say so.
Mom looks in Documents for projects' old build folders, work that isn't backed up, and copies of the same file. She only reads; nothing goes until you say so.
Mom looks on the Desktop for copies of the same file and big files nobody has opened in a year. She only reads; nothing goes until you say so.
Mom asks Finder to move an app to the Trash when the app belongs to the whole Mac and she can't move it herself.
Mom asks when each of your apps last saved its settings, to tell which ones you no longer open. She reads the dates only, never what's inside.
Mom looks at a disk you plugged in only when you added a folder on it, or chose it to keep old conversations on.
Mom looks at a network disk only when you added a folder on it.
